what: The vectors of finding B53-6 of the CCF_7021 interop delivery that proofbundle's own forms carry: the statements of the ALG forms as three scitt-ccf-ledger states served them (00101f76 on CCF 7.0.17, 0288af35 on 7.0.21, ef68d03d on 7.0.22), each with the end-entity key of its own x5chain, and the inclusion receipt of state ef68d03d with its path emptied (M-INC-EMPTY-PATH) beside its unchanged control. The samples of draft -06 itself are not copied here (IETF terms, as in the delivery); tests/test_scitt_ccf_06.py rebuilds them from their README.

source.tools: werkzeug/n53_forms.py, n53_register.py, n53_vectors.py, n53_sigcheck.py of that archive

inclusion.origin_06: -06 2.2: a Verifier holding a Transparent Statement keeps tag 18 and the encoded protected header, payload and signature as received, with an empty unprotected map; -06 3.2: assert(proof.leaf.data-hash == statement_digest); statement_digest computed by the Verifier
inclusion.note: the transparent statement as the state served it

inclusion.origin_06: -06 3: path [* ccf-proof-element]; empty only for a tree of size 1, whose root is the leaf hash; -06 3.2: assert(verify_cose(inclusion_receipt, compute_root(proof)))
inclusion.note: the path emptied; the root becomes the leaf hash, not the signed root
